main_text.l: bi[?],aut tardius,prout natura quęuis est mor-
bi concoctrix,ualidior exiftit, aut debilior:
aut ex eo quòd humores uel tenues sint,
uel crasfi. Hi enim tardius, illi uero celerius
ab ipsa uincuntur natura. Ridiculi quoque
sunt nostri temporis nonnulli medici, qui
summam ægrorum imbecillitatem, & uitæ
discrimen silenti Lunę attribuunt. Primùm
enim siue sileat Luna, siue illustrissima sit,
interdiu tamen in hæc nostratia[?] nihil,aut
imbecillimè agit. Intercipitur nanque uis
eius à Sole, qui tũc agit maximè, terramq;,
aquas, & aërem calefaciens & illustrans. Si
præterea morbus est calidus & siccus, qua-
lis solet esse omnis acutus, ipsa silens Lu-
na, quæ tunc noctem ex accidenti refrige-
rat & humectat, nullam ægri uiribus potest
detrahere noxam: imò uerò potius ipsam
naturam morbo oppressam leuat contra-
rijs qualitatibus, quas nocturno aëri
induxit adversus istum mor-
bum ex diametro pu-
gnans.

page.notes: Doubtful: the first word "bi" has a partly cut first letter (possibly "si"). "nostratia" is uncertain at the line end. "quòd" is printed with a grave accent. Printing errors left as printed: "crasfi" (printed with long s, read as crassi-like form). Catchword "EXER-" and signature "E 2" are at the foot as printed.
